**Not fully confirmed, and persistence can't be assessed yet.**

- **Loss detected:** Hansen GFC shows 13.5 ha of tree-cover loss in 2025, about 3.9% of the 345.6 ha asset.
- **Reference agreement:** JRC GFC2020 maps 98% of the event area as forest in 2020, which meets the ≥50% agreement requirement. The MGAP 2021 map classes 13.1 ha as native forest and none as planted. Only 0.4 ha lies outside mapped forest.
- **Missing criterion:** Corroboration also requires a later year of the series to be observed. 2025 is the latest year available, so no later year exists for this event. The rule is therefore not met.

The loss is real in the Hansen data and was forest beforehand. Whether it is persistent, meaning no regrowth or reversal, can't be shown until 2026 data is released. Treat it as a single-source detection that is unconfirmed under your rule. Note that this is an early-access engine version.
